SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   C. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   D. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   C. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

10. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   C. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   C. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Democracy in school and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Community Leadership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
